functions.name: advanceUtf8SpanWide
functions.signature: (type $t9) (param $p0 i32) (param $p1 i32) (param $p2 i32) (param $p3 i32) (param $p4 i32) (result i32)
functions.notes: Same validator as 1813, except four-byte sequences require two remaining characters and consume two from the limit.

functions.name: advanceUtf8Span
functions.signature: (type $t9) (param $p0 i32) (param $p1 i32) (param $p2 i32) (param $p3 i32) (param $p4 i32) (result i32)
functions.notes: Walks complete UTF-8 sequences from start to end or a character limit and returns bytes consumed; rejects overlong, surrogate, truncated and out-of-range encodings.

validation.comparison: Every case compares the returned byte count. 73 cases also compare all 67,108,864 memory bytes and the stack pointer. Both ids cover valid/invalid sequences, every end offset and limit over mixed spans, and 120 random spans each.
limitations: The end and limit arguments are unsigned; the length checks use signed subtraction as in the original.
Pointers at 0x3ffffff are not exercised; reads stay inside the data span.
1810 counts a four-byte sequence as two characters. Ledger: 351 client bodies recovered and 3,894 remain machine code.
